visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man with short black hair, wearing a light grey t-shirt and black athletic shorts, is filmed from behind while running vigorously on a treadmill. The gym has grey walls and a black treadmill console with lit indicators. (2) The camera angle shifts to his side as he continues running; he looks focused and speaks while maintaining his pace. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (3) He stops running and stands in front of the treadmill, gesturing with his fingers to count 'three' while looking directly at the lens. The background features other gym equipment in a dimly lit studio environment. (4) A sequence of fitness demonstrations begins: first, he performs lat pull-downs, showing his back muscles; a 3D model of a 'Daily B' supplement bottle is overlaid on the left. (5) He is then seen performing barbell curls in a tank top; a bottle of 'EPA70 Fish Oil' appears as an overlay. (6) He pushes a weighted gym sled across the floor; a bottle of 'Maca Capsules' is shown. (7) Returning to the treadmill, he runs while colorful digital confetti graphics burst across the screen. (8) A series of screen recordings from a mobile shopping website 'Phargoods+' scrolls through images of iPhones, health supplements, and promotional banners. (9) He finishes by running on the treadmill again, smiling at the camera while large red and white text displays a discount code.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator running and demonstrating exercises; at least 3 other people (male and female) are visible in the background of the gym scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A muscular East Asian male in his late 20s or 30s with short, styled black hair. He wears a light grey athletic t-shirt, black gym shorts, white socks, and white sneakers.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern, professional gym with grey and wood-paneled walls. Equipment includes treadmills, lat pull-down machines, power racks, barbells, and weighted sleds. The second half of the video features a digital website interface with white and green branding.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the heavy, rhythmic thumping of running footsteps on a treadmill and the sound of slightly heavy breathing. A male voice speaks with high energy and clarity in Traditional Chinese, sounding confident and friendly. (2) A bright, upbeat synth-pop BGM with a steady electronic beat kicks in at 124 BPM. The narrator transitions into a structured advice segment. A sharp 'pop' sound effect punctuates the start of his recommendation list. (3) A 'ding' chime marks the transition to the first supplement detail. The sound of metal weights clanking softly in a gym environment is audible in the background mix. (4) A 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the topic shifts to the second supplement. The narrator maintains a high speech rate with clear enunciation. (5) Another 'ding' chime introduces the third supplement. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (6) A loud, festive 'party popper' or celebratory burst sound effect triggers the promotion phase. The narrator's pitch rises slightly with excitement. (7) Multiple digital UI 'click' and 'pop' sound effects play in rapid succession as various website deals are mentioned. (8) The video concludes with a final 'whoosh' sound and the BGM fading out quickly under the narrator's last call to action.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Information List -> Promotional Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide health supplement recommendations specifically for fitness enthusiasts while leveraging a high-energy gym persona to promote the 'Phargoods+' Double 11 shopping festival and a specific discount code.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct recommendation of specific products, display of brand logos (藥師健生活), and a custom discount code (guy1224) for the website.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-arousal social media style with rapid cuts and frequent sound effects to maintain viewer engagement. The combination of fitness authority and time-sensitive promotional offers creates a strong marketing hook.
